label: Astro 7 (@astrojs/node standalone, Preact island)
streaming: streamed (Astro renders on-demand pages as a chunked stream by default; experimentalDisableStreaming not set)
notes: No compression: the @astrojs/node standalone server sends identity bodies even when the client sends Accept-Encoding: gzip/br (HTML and /_astro assets alike).

Per request: the standalone node:http server runs Astro's app.render() — route match, the (empty) middleware chain, frontmatter (one listItems()/getItem() await), then streams the rendered page in chunks. /_astro/* assets are served from dist/client with immutable cache headers.

Form: Astro Actions with accept:'form' and no input validator (handler gets FormData; validateName() is the rule). The form posts to ?_action=addItem; the page reads Astro.getActionResult() — error → re-render with HTTP 400 and #form-error (ActionError BAD_REQUEST message), success → Astro.redirect (302) to /items/:id. Works without JS; there is no client-side enhancement (plain full-page POST).
The node adapter enables sessions with filesystem storage by default at build; nothing in this app reads Astro.session, so no session cookie or file I/O happens per request.

Only the Counter (Preact, client:load) ships JS: preact runtime + hooks + @preact/signals (pulled in by @astrojs/preact's client renderer) + the island; the page also inlines Astro's astro-island loader script.
Links are plain <a> (Astro's link primitive); no prefetch by default (prefetch is opt-in in Astro config).
Telemetry disabled via ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 in the npm scripts and the harness env.
